defense_news.title: How a French frigate’s radical bow design makes for smooth sailing
defense_news.summary: The inverted bow on the new FDI frigates makes for better seakeeping, said the former French Navy captain who commanded the lead ship of the class during sea trials.

defense_news.title: Shield AI to acquire radar maker Echodyne to bust drones
defense_news.summary: Shield AI's CEO said the purchase of Echodyne supports the company’s aim to branch into different areas of unmanned systems.

defense_news.title: Popular military air show permanently pulled from RAF Fairford after suspected terror threat
defense_news.summary: Over a month after a suspected Iranian plot on RAF Fairford, organizers of the world's largest military air show announced its permanent departure to MOD Boscombe Down.

defense_news.title: Vector introduces ready-to-go one-way attack drone
defense_news.summary: The company said the Warfighter’s Stack consists of the drone, an HV-ESAD to hold an explosive payload, and a remote control.
